title: お知らせ・Webのアイコン
subject_en: Simple web and notice icons, each a separate rounded flat icon on its own, friendly palette (navy, sky blue, orange, mint). Every icon has a closed, clearly darker edge tone around its shape; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters or numbers.
lead: 電話、メール、地図ピン、時計、カレンダー、検索、ホーム、ベル、ダウンロード。サイトのお知らせ、チラシの連絡先、スライドに使えるアイコン12点。
items: a telephone handset icon in a rounded circle
a map location pin with a dot
a round clock face with two hands (no numbers)
a calendar page with a ring binding and a few blank squares
a simple house icon with a door
a notification bell with a small dot
a downward arrow onto a tray
